original_goal:
[Module: Checkout - Overview | TC-005 | Type: Edge/Interaction | Priority: Medium]
Title: Rapid double-click of Finish does not create duplicate orders

▶ Start URL:    https://www.saucedemo.com/checkout-step-two.html
▶ Requires Auth: Yes
▶ Test Data:
{
  "user": "standard_user"
}

Preconditions:
  User is signed in; items are in cart; Checkout – Overview step is visible with order summary

Steps to Execute:
  1. Click the **Finish** button
  2. Immediately click the **Finish** button again (within one second)
  3. Observe the UI until navigation to the Confirmation page completes

Expected Result:
  First submission succeeds; the second click is blocked or ignored (Finish button is disabled or a processing indicator appears); only one Confirmation page is shown and no duplicate order is created

Notes from prior verification:
  Manually verified for completion.
